text:
maria: FYI seeing a sudden spike in spot_preempt_rate for eu-west3 GPU pools around 03:12 UTC. link: https://dash.internal/spot-availability/eu-west3
alex: interruption_rate up from ~2% -> ~8% across a100/p4d. noticed packet-loss metrics rising too :thinking_face:
sam: any scheduled maint or pricing blip from cloud? checked provider status, nothing listed
autoscale-bot: Autoscaler event - scaled up +12 nodes in eu-west3-gpu at 2026-05-02T03:14:27Z (reason: pending pods)
jen: eviction_score heatmap shows clustering in zone-b; same nodes show increased network drop counts and interface resets
lia: can we map which K8s workloads hit? I suspect large batching rerank jobs from Search
dave: Search confirmed a heavy rerank at 03:10 UTC; they increased batch_size yesterday to speed throughput
alex: that combo (big batches + spot churn + transient network drops) is a recipe for spike in retries and errors
maria: short mitigations proposed: (1) enable mixed-capacity fallback (spot -> on-demand) for eu-west3 nodegroups, (2) throttle rerank batch sizes via feature flag, (3) add rolling-10m median to alert to reduce flapping
sam: also add 60s autoscaler cooldown to avoid rapid add/remove cycles during an event
jen: question: do we have spare on-demand in region? last inventory ~20% free only
dave: we could preempt a few lower-priority dedicated instances, but that risks impacting other services
lia: runbook update suggestion: add step to trigger regional fallback if spot_preempt_rate > 5% for 5m AND SLO_error_budget_consumption > 10%
alex: I'll canary a k8s patch to enable mixed pools on 2 nodegroups, then roll if stable
maria: create a temporary dashboard widget: compare(interruption_rate, eviction_score) and add log filter "node.killed.*preempt" for timeline
autoscale-bot: Alert: spot_preempt_rate eu-west3 > 5% for 3m. Pager sent to eng-infra on-call.
oncall-ops: ack - starting mitigation checklist. reduced search-service rerank batch by 40% via feature flag
dave: confirmed reduced error spikes after throttling; retries down
jen: follow-up: change interruption alert to use rolling median(10m) to avoid reacting to short blips
lia: also auto-annotate incident timeline when fallback policy toggles so product teams can trace customer impact
alex: cost question: brief fallback to on-demand for 2h vs continued degraded retries/latency. anyone run numbers?
maria: quick calc: on-demand for additional 2h ~ +$1.6k in infra spend for eu-west3, estimate customer-visible cost (latency/errors) harder to quantify but potentially larger
dave: suggest initial fallback window 30m then reassess; also route high-qps traffic to dedicated-only hosts where possible
jen: I'll PR runbook updates and the alert threshold change. tagging @product for visibility
search-bot: Notified Search Product: "Potential impact from eu-west3 spot volatility. See eng-infra thread."
product: thanks, we'll monitor the customer dashboards and adjust throttles if needed
lia: post-incident actions: (1) tighten eviction_score and network-drop telemetry, (2) add mixed-capacity playbook entry with cost estimates, (3) add chaos test simulating large-batch rerank under spot volatility
maria: if fallback resolves issue, we'll close alert and log the cost delta in weekly infra report
alex: canary applied to 2 nodegroups, fallback enabled, monitoring for stabilization
oncall-ops: interruption_rate trending down to ~2.5% over last 6m
dave: Search confirms error rate back to baseline
maria: closing loop - alert resolved. scheduling retro tomorrow 09:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
